answer: Farming becomes a trellis bet on surviving 118 epochs of grading, and every vine settlement recomputes the walnut schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 118 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
